discovery.description: Use IANA RDAP bootstrap and the authoritative registry RDAP service to compare a domain registration date against a caller-selected minimum age. Returns established, recent_registration, unregistered, or human_review. Domain age alone does not establish ownership, control, legitimacy, fraud risk, safety, or business history.
discovery.resource_description: Determine whether a domain's authoritative RDAP registration date is at least a caller-selected age. Returns established, recent_registration, unregistered, or human_review. Domain age is an identity signal, not a fraud, legitimacy, safety, or ownership verdict.

buyer.task: Determine whether an authoritative RDAP domain registration date is at least a caller-selected minimum age.

expected_purchase_frequency.measurement_plan: Measure independent settled purchases and repeat buyers per product after launch; do not infer demand from tests or crawler probes.

sources.authority: IANA DNS bootstrap plus authoritative registry RDAP
sources.refresh_policy: authoritative domain lookup on each paid request
sources.cache_policy: IANA bootstrap cached in memory for adapter lifetime; authoritative domain result not cached

rules: Use authoritative RDAP registration/registered event date when present.
Compute domain age at UTC day granularity.
Return unregistered when authoritative RDAP reports the domain is not registered.

Return established when registration date is on or before the minimum-age cutoff; return recent_registration when newer; return human_review when required RDAP evidence or registration date is unavailable.

failure_behavior.required_source_failure: HTTP 502 with chargeable=false; do not settle payment.
failure_behavior.payment_unresolved: HTTP 503; caller should retry the same payment authorization.

criteria: Release gate passes from the same registry revision.
Authoritative live-source smoke passes without source failures.
Shared non-credit-gated hosting is available and measured.
Post-allowance unit economics are settlement-negative at the current price; commercial promotion remains blocked until economics are repaired or an explicit exception is approved.
